correctness.rationale: The cyclic rule is right-permutive. Distinct colliding inputs cannot have consecutive matches or a shared 1. If a shared 0 occurs, the equation forces shared zeros at distance two, so the inputs are single-parity; with no shared zeros the mismatched pairs must alternate 01,10, again single-parity. The output-zero parity equations show that mixed-parity inputs stay mixed, hence that sector is a permutation. On single-parity words the dynamics swaps support parity and is a shift times D=I+S. The exact multiplicity h of z+1 in z^m-1 gives rank(D^t)=m-min(t,h); D^h=I+S^h has the stated residue-class even-sum image. Combining the two half-images with their shared zero and the mixed sector gives the rank formula; successive rank drops give the stated exact Jordan census. At n=2, 00 and 11 are fixed and both other states map to 00, as predicted. Independent replay: python3 -B /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py 2; all 5,460 states at six even lengths matched periodic membership, ranks and block counts. This is finite corroboration only.
